entries.09cfad2e7ff7e3fb: Members Co., Ltd. is a company in which dedicated teams of digital creators work alongside client companies to support their digitalization, from production to data utilization and decarbonization.
entries.1eafcccb8b9f9119: This is the single segment of the company group, consisting of 11 divisions, 21 internal companies belonging to those divisions, and one consolidated subsidiary. Digital creators, three or more per team, form dedicated teams for client companies and provide hands-on support that advances digitalization alongside clients. Revenue from external customers by product and service in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,555 million for DX accompanying support, ¥866 million for advertising, and ¥2 million for other.
